maria gonzalez: Hey team — starting today! Quick q: who do I ping for HubSpot seat + Dialpad voicemail transfer? Also where's the latest demo deck and objection-handling playbook? Thanks!

oliver (sales-ops): @maria gonzalez welcome! I filed the HubSpot seat request (`IT-5678`). Dialpad voicemail needs your email + direct number — DM me that. Demo deck: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sales/demo_deck_v3.pdf. Playbook (objections): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sales/objection-playbook.

kayla it: Got the ticket IT-5678, provisioning HubSpot now. HubSpot SSO + Gong provisioning are tied, so give it ~30min. For Dialpad voicemail transfer we need the current number you want forwarded from — paste it here or DM.

maria gonzalez: DM'd my email and mobile. Also, do I need to opt into call recording for Gong? Any consent steps?

michelle enablement: Gong access auto-provisions after HubSpot seat + SSO. If it doesn't appear ping me. Use `demo_deck_v3.pdf` for pitches — it's the canonical version. Tip: see slide 12 "Pricing Objections" for rebut scripts. I'll drop the quick scripts here in a sec.

ron manager: Welcome aboard, Maria! First-week plan: 1) Watch 2 shadow calls, 2) run through the playbook sections, 3) schedule 3 discovery calls by EOW. I'll set up pairing with an AE for shadowing. Ping me if you want a faster ramp.

onboarding-bot: Welcome maria gonzalez! New-hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklist — Current status: 0/7 tasks completed.

oliver (sales-ops): Dialpad voicemail transfer scheduled for 09:30 today, I'll cc you on the support ticket. If you want a custom voicemail greeting, @michelle enablement has templates.

maria gonzalez: Thanks — one more: where are one-pagers and customer battlecards stored? Need them for call prep.

michelle enablement: All collateral lives in Notion under Sales > Collateral. Quick links: https://notion.redwood/sales/collateral (one-pagers) and https://notion.redwood/sales/collateral/battlecards (battlecards). I'll paste the top 5 battlecards here momentarily.

michelle enablement: Pasted top 3 battlecards: 1) "Price vs Value" (Enterprise), 2) "Low-Latency Hook" (Startups), 3) "Compliance & Private Deploy" (Regulated). DM me if you want tailored talking points. :mag: 

kayla it: HubSpot seat is active ✅. You should see synced contacts and email logging in ~10min. If SSO fails, try a hard refresh and let IT know.

maria gonzalez: Confirmed HubSpot access, Gong still pending. Thanks everyone — really appreciate the fast turnaround! :heart:
